title: Integrable, Mixed, and Chaotic Dynamics in a Single All-to-All Ising Spin Model
summary: We demonstrate that the Ising all-to-all (ATA) model exhibits a range of dynamics, from integrable to chaotic, including mixed behaviour across symmetry blocks within a single system. While other works have explored the dynamics of all-to-all systems by varying parameters, we analyse a fixed set of parameters and examine the dynamics within different blocks. In addition to investigating the dynamical properties, we show that the system remains resilient to noise when the norm of the Hamiltonian representing the noise is close to 1.
